audio_description:
A forest with a grazing deer, mountains beyond.
Galbadia Garden slides in behind the trees.

context.scene_title: Galbadia Garden on the move — the mobile red Garden glides through forested wilderness (lead-up to the Battle of the Gardens, Disc 2).
locations: A forest of tall trees with distant mountains; the red bulk of Galbadia Garden passing behind the treeline

characters.name: (woodland deer)
characters.recognition: A spotted deer grazes peacefully in the foreground before the Garden appears; ambient wildlife, not a character.

context.summary: A tranquil forest with a spotted deer grazing, mountains beyond — then the massive red form of the now-mobile Galbadia Garden slides into view behind the trees, revealing that Galbadia Garden too has taken to moving in pursuit.
context.context_note: High confidence: the mobile Galbadia Garden (its distinctive red form) traveling, presaging the Battle of the Gardens.
